ImageDescription.value: Tsui Sing Lau Pagoda is a historic declared Chinese pagoda located in Tin Shui Wai, New Territories, Hong Kong. Believed to have been built in the late 15th century during the Ming dynasty, it is the only remaining ancient pagoda in Hong Kong. Traditionally associated with feng shui practices, the structure was erected to improve the local fortune.
